Common questions

What is static hosting?

Static hosting serves files exactly as they are: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images. With no server code to run, sites are fast and simple to maintain.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes. Add your domain in the dashboard, update your DNS records, and HTTPS is set up for you.

Which frameworks work?

Anything that builds to plain files works, including Hugo, Astro, Vite, Eleventy and Jekyll. Upload the build output folder.

Can I undo a bad deploy?

Yes. Previous deploys are kept, so you can roll back to an earlier version.
